notes.display_state: console display state (0 off, 1 on, 2 dimmed) logged before every step and every 5 s (display-state.log); see display_state_per_step
notes.overlay_ready: ready_ms = start of the final unbroken stretch in which an overlay window of the tool is visible, uncloaked, covers >= 95% of a monitor and has the rect it still has 600 ms after it first became visible. visible_ms = first such window at any size.
notes.slow_runs: runs more than 150 ms above the tool's median ready_ms
notes.triggers: Stinkshot, ShareX, Flameshot: CLI (a forwarding process is started every trial). Greenshot: WM_HOTKEY posted to its main form (no process start, lower bound).
notes.flameshot_picker: Flameshot 15 shows a monitor picker on this mixed-DPI layout; its overlay ready is command -> picker shown
notes.cold_launch: cold-0: region command 30 ms after launch; cold-1: 1 ms after the tray window exists. Process killed and 3 s pause between runs; file caches warm.
notes.previous_runs: second run (displays off, b5409a9) in results-second-run; first run in results-first-run
